submit.title: Submit Your Question Pack
submit.description: Write your own quiz pack for an NDQuest game. Add as many questions as you like, pick a difficulty for each, then send it in. Our team reviews every submission before it goes live.
submit.languageOptionalHint: You only need to fill in one language - Portuguese or English. Leave the other blank and we'll use the same text for both.
submit.bulkHint: Paste multiple questions at once, or upload a .txt file in the same format. Difficulty and language are both optional - defaults to medium difficulty, and one language is enough.
submit.addQuestion: Add a Question One at a Time
submit.answerHint: Fill in the 4 answers in at least one language, then mark which one is correct.
